claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (CMV/ASSIST/AutoFlow, PEEP 5 cmH2O, set RR 16, tidal volume 500 mL, FiO2 40%), monitoring peak and plateau pressures and minute volume.
Continue supplemental oxygen via ventilator at FiO2 40% and monitor SpO2 to maintain saturation above the desaturation limit of 88%.

Monitor arterial blood gas and electrolytes, including the persistent anion gap metabolic acidosis (anion gap 21, bicarbonate 16, pH 7.30) and base excess -5, with repeat testing as clinically indicated.
Monitor serum magnesium and calcium given hypomagnesemia (1.3 mg/dL) and hypocalcemia (total calcium 7.8 mg/dL), with repeat levels to assess response to repletion.
Monitor temperature and white blood cell count (16.2 K/uL, 15.1 K/uL) for evolving infection, given ongoing ampicillin-sulbactam therapy.
Continue ampicillin-sulbactam 3 g IV as active antimicrobial therapy.
Monitor pain and continue multimodal analgesia, including IV hydromorphone and IV acetaminophen as ordered, reassessing pain scores.
Monitor blood glucose (finger stick 105 mg/dL, serum 151 mg/dL) and continue glycemic monitoring.
Maintain and monitor the arterial line, central venous introducer, peripheral IV, and Foley catheter, including site/dressing checks and zeroing/calibration of the arterial line.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine gluconate 0.12% oral rinse and subglottic suctioning as part of ventilator-associated pneumonia prevention.
